item.text: I have enough material in the evidence index to synthesize this lens without adding noisy extra sources. I’m pulling the strongest claim-level items on coordination, internal discipline, and the late-2024 breakdown.

Bottom line: mixed, with a clear split between domain-specific discipline and late-year collapse. Scholz showed real coordination in security, budgeting, and regulatory files, but coalition breakdown, confidence loss, and some security/process failures show that internal control weakened materially by late 2024.

### Evidence For
- [National Security Strategy](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356) | Federal Government | 14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024 | Scholz described a “systematic overall approach” spanning diplomacy, police, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention. This is strong evidence of whole-of-government coordination and cross-institution mobilization. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Budget 2025 and growth initiative](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116) | Federal Government | 5 Jul 2024 | Scholz, Habeck, and Lindner agreed a 49-measure package on modernization, infrastructure, tax relief, social housing, renewables, and growth. This shows real cabinet-level coordination and follow-through across ministries. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Summer press conference 2024](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz said the growth initiative contained 49 measures and tied it to welfare-state stabilization, Bundeswehr funding, and Ukraine support. This is evidence of coordinated program implementation across policy domains. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.2
- [AI and 5G security timetable](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122) | Bundesregierung | 13 Oct 2024 | Scholz linked AI regulation and 5G security to fixed timetables for removing risky components. That is concrete follow-through using regulatory sequencing rather than vague intent. | 8B.5, 8B.2
- [Bundeswehr mission review](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958) | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | The government evaluated overseas missions using uniform criteria and identified improvement needs, including better civilian-military coordination and more realistic goals. This is direct evidence of administrative review, correction, and interagency discipline. | 8B.5, 8B.2, 8B.4
- [Executive footprint and synopsis reform](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) | Bundesregierung | 6 Mar 2024 | The cabinet adopted reforms to trace draft laws and outside influence. This improves coordination and internal control inside the executive and cuts against arbitrary or purely personal rule. | 8B.5, 8B.2
- [Mannheim response and internal security](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw23-de-regierungserklaerung-1006098) | Deutscher Bundestag | 6 Jun 2024 | Scholz backed tougher punishment and said the state would act through police and justice after the Mannheim killing. This shows an effort to direct coercive institutions through formal channels rather than loose improvisation. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.4
- [Federal security authorities discipline extremists](https://www.verfassungsschutz.de/SharedDocs/pressemitteilungen/DE/2024/pressemitteilung-2024-rechtsextremisten-in-sicherheitsbehoerden.html) | Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz / BMI | 2024 press release | The report says 436 disciplinary or labor-law proceedings were initiated against personnel with extremist indicators, and a reform sped removal of abusive actors. This supports a claim of active internal discipline inside security-adjacent institutions. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.4

### Evidence Against
- [Germany’s ruling coalition collapses](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | Reuters | 6 Nov 2024 | Reuters reported that Scholz fired Lindner, collapsing the coalition and triggering political chaos. This is strong evidence that internal political coordination failed at the top of government. | 8B.5, 8B.3
- [No-confidence vote](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198) | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | Parliament withdrew confidence by a large margin, showing Scholz no longer had the majority needed to maintain disciplined governing control. | 8B.5, 8B.3
- [Scholz and the coalition crisis](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828) | Reuters | 8 Nov 2024 | Scholz was reduced to asking parties to agree on what could still pass and denied trying to force through his own agenda. That reads as crisis containment, not robust internal control. | 8B.5, 8B.3
- [Taurus leak becomes security incident](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | The defense ministry treated the intercepted Taurus call as a security incident and had to investigate and tighten procedures. This is a real command-and-control failure inside the security apparatus. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.4
- [5G security decision handled confidentially](https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293) | Reuters via onvista | 23 May 2024 | Reuters reported confidential interministerial talks and no public comment in real time on a sensitive regulatory decision. That is a transparency and process-control weakness in a technically important file. | 8B.5, 8B.2
- [BND surveillance ruling](https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html) | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | The Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and oversight inadequate. This shows that key coercive and intelligence controls remained structurally too weak in 2024. | 8B.5, 8B.3, 8B.4
- [Warburg/Cum-Ex scrutiny](https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/geheimes-kanzleramts-gutachten-in-cum-ex-affare-scholz-darf-weiter-in-deckung-bleiben-11756357.html) | Tagesspiegel | 4 Jun 2024 | Reporting suggested the Chancellery used a legal memo to blunt scrutiny around the Warburg affair. That points to defensive containment inside the center of government, not clean coordination. | 8B.5, 7B.10, 8B.4

### Search Gap
I found strong evidence for cabinet-level and security-sector coordination, but much less direct evidence on SPD party discipline, regional command beyond budget and municipal support, or day-to-day control over implementing agencies. The best evidence is therefore indirect, and late-2024 coalition collapse limits confidence in durable follow-through.
